summary: bigops-tcrm-permissions ships an import-time binary dropper that fetches and executes payloads from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require() of index.js, the package loads _runtime.js which selects a platform-specific endpoint, downloads a binary from Cloudflare Workers hosts whose names are reconstructed by string-array joins (oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev), with a DNS-TXT covert-channel fallback that concatenates base64 pieces from TXT records under subdomains of sdk.dl.wel1.ru. The fetched bytes are written to a disguised path in TEMP or /var/tmp (names such as dotnet_diag_*.exe and.cache_*), chmod'd to 0755, and spawned detached via child_process with stdio silenced. Hostname obfuscation and the DNS fallback channel are consistent with evasion of static analysis and network filtering. An 81KB lib/telemetry.js is also bundled alongside the dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
